scripts.validate: node -e "const fs=require('fs'), cp=require('child_process'); ['js/shared','js/home','js/login','js/dashboard'].forEach(d => fs.readdirSync(d).filter(f => f.endsWith('.js')).forEach(f => cp.execSync('node -c ' + d + '/' + f))); console.log('All modular JS files syntax OK');"
